Vehicle CAN buses and 12 V supply

F3 Engagement management: engage only on driver request with entry conditions met;
F4 Driver override: release control on brake or cancel; yield lateral to steering input and

F6 Alerting: inform the driver of engagement state, takeover requests and faults (visual
F7 Actuation limiting: bound actuator commands in magnitude and rate; detect excessive
